text:
Situation: Sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim 800 mg/160 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 401 tablets (26.9 days at 14.9 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 469 tablets (29.5 days at 15.9 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately four weeks at both sites. No national shortage is declared. Supply continuity depends on timely procurement from qualified manufacturers.

Recommended actions:
1. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (plant: Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, last inspection NAI 2024-07-19) — buyer to execute, P&T committee to approve vendor qualification.
2. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC (plant: AMNEAL PHARMS NY) — buyer to execute, P&T committee to approve vendor qualification.
3. Evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvKARE, and AvPAK for future qualification pending plant identification — buyer to research, P&T committee to approve if plant data becomes verifiable.
4. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes at next P&T meeting — buyer to track, P&T committee to review.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time. Clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
